sentences.en: The public school system is coming apart at the seams.
sentences.zh: 公立教育系统已经千疮百孔。

sentences.en: Please take in the seams of the jacket a little.
sentences.zh: 请把夹克衫的缝线稍微收一下。

sentences.en: In order to fix this mistake we'll have to tear out this seam.
sentences.zh: 为了纠正这个错误，我们必须拆开这条缝线。

phrases.zh: 到了极限；快要撑不住了
